assumptions: Chosen format: 1920×1080 widescreen, twelve 15-second scenes, English captions, and an original instrumental score without narration.

Research scope is the completed June–August 2026 summer, rather than the whole calendar year. National anomalies, rankings and trend come from [JMA seasonal temperatures](https://www.data.jma.go.jp/cpdinfo/temp/sum_jpn.html).
Regional contrasts come from [JMA’s summer 2026 weather summary](https://www.data.jma.go.jp/cpd/longfcst/seasonal/202608/202608s.html).

Heat mechanisms and cumulative extreme-temperature observations are attributed to [JMA’s September analysis](https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/press/2609/01c/kentoukai20260901.html) and [August heat release](https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/press/2608/03b/japan_hot20260803.html). Station-days count repeated observations, not unique locations.
All artwork is original Canvas drawing. Geography and atmospheric diagrams are schematic; decorative marks do not represent additional measurements. Chromatic offsets are confined to drawn strokes.
The JavaScript synthesizer deterministically generates an embedded 180-second WAV for the framework-owned audio clip. HyperFrames must include that clip in its audio mix.
No third-party images, fonts, logos or recordings are used. JMA factual data are attributed; JMA reuse terms have not been independently audited.
This source has not been rendered, listened to or visually reviewed.
